essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: Malcolm's formal articulation of Both/And vs Either/Or asymmetry (BA contains EO but not reverse)
essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text:
Both/And thinking and Either/Or thinking don't have a symmetric relationship. BA can contain EO but not the reverse.

In Both/And thinking, you can have BOTH both/and AND either/or.
In Either/Or thinking, you can have EITHER both/and OR either/or.
